query:
ONE QUESTION (round 3, evidence attached): Does the broker-proof wind-down rung in the CURRENT working tree satisfy Trey's ruling (a) and its five non-negotiable conditions? Conditions: (1) ghost broker leg registered INTO state FROM broker truth (symbol/side/qty/entry from the broker answer, scope from session runtime scope), born quarantined and tagged STALE_BROKER_ORPHAN, eligible for exit only; (2) journal + max-priority ntfy trace at registration and at close; (3) close through the ORDINARY exit path with KILL-5 satisfied by the registered identity, no special close mechanism; (4) broker RE-READ is the only proof of flat, windDownFlattenComplete true on broker [] only; (5) close failing again -> flatten_failed, boundary shut, failed-safe, floor never removed. Plus: no new gate/flag/config knob/throw; broker read rejection = unverifiable -> failed-safe, process alive; both directions; no fabricated entry price.

Mercury's round-2 answer is followed by a VERBATIM EVIDENCE PACKET that was machine-extracted with sed/grep/git from the working tree (not LLM-authored). Treat the packet as the quoted code the prior rounds lacked. If every condition is evidenced by the quoted code, say VERDICT: pass. If any is broken, name the exact quoted line.

This claim is therefore unsupported.
